原: I’m glad to hear you find my work accessible, because I was worried.
疑为: I’m glad to hear you find my work accessible, because I was worried, when I wrote it, that discussing the science might make the book more suited for a specialist audience.
理由: 第45、46句本是一句：worried 后接 that 从句，句号把它切断了，第46句“When I wrote it, that…”单独不成句。

原: Can you give us the basics of your advice for people who want to lose weight, briefly, I argue that every person needs to consider their metabolism and eat what suits their body’s needs.
疑为: Can you give us the basics of your advice for people who want to lose weight? / Briefly, I argue that every person needs to consider their metabolism and eat what suits their body’s needs.
理由: 两个说话人的话连成了一句：前半是主持人的提问（问号漏掉），Briefly 以后是嘉宾的回答。

原: They also want to make their home a safe place.
疑为: They also want to make their home a safe place, free from toxic chemicals.
理由: 第146句“Free from toxic chemicals.”是第145句的后置修饰，被句号切成了两句。

原: …after he fished out thousands of dollars in change over 34.
疑为: …after he fished out thousands of dollars in change over 34 years using a magnetic stick.
理由: over 34 years 被句号从中间切断，第179句“Years using a magnetic stick.”应接在第178句后面。
